hooks.command: n=$(ls .ai/inbox/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); w=$(ls .ai/working/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || [ "$w" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Visual feedback: %s new in .ai/inbox/, %s in .ai/working/ awaiting the user\u2019s confirmation. Each carries an exact file:line from a click in the running app. Mention this and offer the react-feedback skill. Claim an entry by moving it to .ai/working/; NEVER write to or read .ai/done/ \u2014 only the user closes feedback, from the toolbar. Do not read the inbox unless asked."}}' "$n" "$w"; fi
